name: smwsprites-thwompin-chuck
title: Thwompin' Chuck
description:
An amalgamate of a chuck and a thwomp, combining their powers into one entity.

The "thwomp" part detects x position and the smash, while the chuck adds the jump and the movement. Extra bit gives the sprite more hitpoints, which can be useful for bosses. Extra Byte 1 changes it's x speed (08 by default) and Extra Byte 2 changes it's jump power. There's also a setting which allows the Thwompin Chuck to end the level if the extra bit is set (the "boss" mode).

Unlike the 2022 Mad Scientist version, this one has more compressed graphics and no longer needs custom palettes. If for whatever reason you want the old version, seek the download found in the competition thread.

Please give credit if used. Thank you.
